methodologyNotes: Re-verified 2026-06-18 via WebFetch on official pricing pages plus corroborating review sources. CONFIRMED on official pages (200 OK): Beacons (beacons.ai/i/pricing), Stan Store (stan.store/blog/stan-store-pricing/), Milkshake (milkshake.app/pricing/). Linktree (linktr.ee/s/pricing) returned 403 to WebFetch but prices $8/$15/$35 and fee structure (Free 12%, Starter/Pro 9%, Premium 0%) were corroborated across 3+ independent 2026 review sources (qr-verse, talkspresso, saasworthy). REMOVED Koji: Linktree acquired Koji and shut down the product on 2026-01-31 wait corrected to 2024-01-31; koji.page no longer serves the link-in-bio mini-app platform described (domain now shows an unrelated sales-page product). Tap.bio prices CORRECTED to Silver $3 / Gold $8 (draft's $5/$12 were inflated and falsely attributed to socialmediacurve, which states $3/$8); Tap.bio is winding down (shutdown 2026-10-31, new signups restricted). Shorby free trial corrected to 14 days. Snipfeed/Planoly Creator Store excluded (acquired, page 403). All accessedAt = 2026-06-18.

plans.name: Pro
